notes: Soft-lit, rounded and toy-like, so each character reads as a small object on the desk. The face stays large and calm, and the personality comes from one moving part per character.

wizard.defs: <linearGradient id="wizard-hat" x1="0" y1="-130" x2="0" y2="-50" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#7c6fe0"/><stop offset=".6" stop-color="#43379b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#231b62"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="wizard-beard" cx="-12" cy="46" r="72" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff"/><stop offset=".7" stop-color="#e6dfd3"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#a89f92"/></radialGradient><linearGradient id="wizard-wood" x1="90" y1="0" x2="110" y2="0" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#b98551"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#5a3a1e"/></linearGradient><radialGradient id="wizard-spark"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffbe0"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#ffd76a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ffb02e" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
wizard.css: .c-wizard .wiz-staff{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}.c-wizard .wiz-hat{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%;transition:transform .5s}.c-wizard .wiz-spark{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;opacity:.25}.c-wizard .wiz-stars{opacity:0}.c-wizard.s-work .wiz-staff{animation:wizTap 1.1s ease-in-out infinite}.c-wizard.s-work .wiz-spark{animation:wizSpark 1.1s ease-out infinite}.c-wizard.s-read .wiz-hat{transform:rotate(5deg) translateY(3px)}.c-wizard.s-happy .wiz-staff{animation:wizLift 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}.c-wizard.s-happy .wiz-stars{animation:wizStars 1.4s ease-out infinite}@keyframes wizTap{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}40%{transform:translateY(-7px) rotate(2deg)}55%{transform:translateY(1px)}}@keyframes wizSpark{0%{opacity:.2;transform:translateY(8px) scale(.7)}35%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1.1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-16px) scale(.8)}}@keyframes wizLift{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-16px) rotate(4deg)}}@keyframes wizStars{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}40%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px)}}

duck.css: .c-duck .duck-wing{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:70% 10%}.c-duck.s-work .whole{animation:duckBob 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.c-duck.s-read .whole{transform:translateY(5px) scale(1.04);transition:transform .4s}.c-duck.s-happy .whole{animation:duckHop .9s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1) infinite}.c-duck.s-happy .duck-wing{animation:duckFlap .3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes duckBob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(2px) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) rotate(2deg)}}@keyframes duckHop{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}45%{transform:translateY(-22px)}}@keyframes duckFlap{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(22deg)}}
